server_alias.description: Additional names (ServerAlias), space-separated. Leave empty for none.

document_root.description: DocumentRoot directory served by this vhost.

allow_override.description: AllowOverride for the document root (.htaccess scope).

listen_port.description: Port for a plain-HTTP vhost (ignored when TLS is enabled, which uses 443).

proxy_pass.description: Reverse-proxy target (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/). Needs mod_proxy. Empty = serve files.

tls_enabled.description: Terminate HTTPS here (VirtualHost *:443, SSLEngine on). Needs mod_ssl.

ssl_cipher_suite.description: SSLCipherSuite for TLS 1.2 (Mozilla Intermediate). Empty = Apache default.

hsts.description: Send HSTS header (needs mod_headers). Only enable once HTTPS works.

redirect_to_https.description: Add a port-80 vhost that permanently redirects to HTTPS.

extra_directives.description: Additional raw directives inside the vhost (e.g. 'LimitRequestBody 20971520').
